text: Objective To improve the accessibility of publications that were wholly or partially funded by the Northern Contaminants Program (NCP).

Lynne Howard Arctic Science and Technology Information System (ASTIS), Arctic Institute of North America, University of Calgary, 2500 University Dr. NW, Calgary, Alberta, T2N 1N4, 403-220-4032, howard@ucalgary.ca Publications included in the database  books and reports  chapters within books or reports  journal papers  conference papers and abstracts  theses  pamphlets  newsletters and newsletter articles  CD-ROMs  audio CDs  videocassettes  websites Progress We have so far identified 2921 publications resulting from research and communication activities that were funded by the NCP. This includes 1010 papers in the Synopsis of Research volumes, 742 journal papers, and 1169 other publications.
As of 3 Sept. 2013, we have obtained, cited, abstracted, and indexed 2885 of the 2921 identified NCP publications to create the NCP Publications Database.
Database records contain information about one or more libraries where the publication is available for interlibrary loan.
Publications available on the Web are hyperlinked: 707 records have URLs that take you directly to the PDF files of the publications.

Of the 738 journal papers in the NCP Database, 572 now have DOIs (digital object identifiers). DOIs in the NCP Database are hyperlinked. Clicking on the DOI will take you to the publisher's website and, if your organization has a subscription, to a PDF file of the paper.

The NCP Publications Database is available at: www.aina.ucalgary.ca/ncp NCP Publications Database records are included in other polar databases We are making our NCP records available in other widely-used polar databases, including the main Arctic Science and Technology Information System (ASTIS) database, the IPY Publications Database and ASTIS subset databases such as the Yukon Biodiversity Database, the Inuvialuit Settlement Region Database, the Nunavut Database, and the Nunavik Bibliography.

The NCP Publications Database may be searched by: words in the title or abstract broad subject area  contaminant  plant or animal  geographic region  community  author  publication type  year You can help To make the NCP Publications Database as complete as possible, ASTIS requests that all NCP-funded researchers report their publications to us at the address above.
